title: Accountability and Reform Research Consortium
summary: ARRC connects researchers and public-interest partners to document changes in government capacity, workforce expertise, communities, service delivery, and the data infrastructure needed for accountable reform.
body_html:
ARRC is a multi-institutional research network designed to document and explain rapid changes in public administration while building durable data and communities of practice.

Its four pillars focus on government capacity; workforce and expertise; structural and societal impacts; and data and analytical infrastructure.
